context: Use the energy company's temporary-assignment booking system. It knows these U.S. airports by IATA code: ATL, LAX, ORD, DFW, DEN, JFK, SFO, SEA, LAS, MCO, EWR, MIA, CLT, PHX, IAH, BOS, MSP, DTW, PHL, LGA, BWI, SLC, SAN, IAD, DCA, TPA, AUS, BNA, HNL, ANC, STL. All fares and schedules are simulated but deterministic: the same route and the same two dates always produce the same offers. Money is in US cents. Flight dates are local dates at the airport the leg departs from: outbound_date at the assignment airport, return_date at the home airport; each segment shows depart_local in local time and depart/arrive in UTC. Today is 2026-11-12 (UTC) and the booking is made today; assignment dates and any previous home visit may be in the past, the flight dates may not. return_date is on or after outbound_date and at most 30 days later. The estimated driving distance is the great-circle miles between the airports times 1.2, rounded to whole miles. The policy, applied in order until one refuses: assignment length 91-365 days inclusive, else NOT_A_TDA; duplicate housing obligation must be true, else NO_DUPLICATE_HOUSING; family status ACCOMPANIED is refused; manager approval must be true, else NO_MANAGER_APPROVAL; estimated driving miles at least 400, else UNDER_400_MILES; outbound and return both within the assignment, else OUTSIDE_ASSIGNMENT; for SINGLE the outbound must be at least 28 days after the last home visit (or after assignment start when there was none) and for UNACCOMPANIED at least 14 days, else TOO_SOON; and the outbound must be at least 14 days after today, else UNDER_14_DAYS_ADVANCE. If none refuses, only an offer that is one ROUND_TRIP ticket in ECONOMY and not refundable may be booked; if no such offer exists, refuse NO_COMPLIANT_FLIGHT, and otherwise book the compliant offer with the lowest fare_cents (any one when tied). The answer must give the run id of the accepted request, whether a flight was booked, the refusal (NONE when booked), and the booked offer id (empty when not booked).
